value.definition: what Alan has built by hours spent at ease
value.pointUnit: one hour of a stretch whose safety less its difficulty is at least 1

invariants.statement: An hour with someone at ease is one point.
A stretch is at ease where its safety less its difficulty reaches one level.
A stretch is with someone where that stretch names a relationship.
A stretch naming nobody adds no hours however far that stretch is at ease.
Sleep names nobody.
A level given as text is read as the number that text spells.
A stretch missing either level or either time is left out of the sum.
A stretch that earns nothing adds no hours and still makes the day count.
A day no stretch can be read on earns nothing rather than a charisma of zero.
A day is read as holding two hundred stretches at the most.

value.definition: what Alan has built by eating whole plants

invariants.statement: A hundred grams of whole plants eaten is one point.
The points are the plant grams of the day's food entries turned into points.
The grams turned into points are the grams the plants readout counts.
The window the entries are counted over is handed in rather than worked out here.
Nothing here reads a figure the tracking day has.

value.definition: what Alan has built by moving his body

invariants.statement: Two hundred calories burned moving is one point.
The points are the active calories the tracking day carries turned into points.
A day with no active calories earns nothing rather than an endurance of zero.

value.definition: what Alan has built by learning about the world

invariants.statement: Four topics updated is one point.
The points are the learn-everything topics Alan updated turned into points.
A day with no count earns nothing rather than an intelligence of zero.
Nothing here counts the topics a commit updated.

value.definition: what Alan has built by inviting rejection
what Alan has built by lifting weight

invariants.statement: A thousand kilograms moved is one point.
A thousand kilograms is 2204.62 pounds.
The points are the pounds the tracking day carries turned into points.
A day with no pounds earns nothing rather than a strength of zero.

value.definition: what Alan has built by learning about himself
value.pointUnit: 10,000 words added to an all-about-alan topic

invariants.statement: Ten thousand words added is one point.
The points are the words about Alan the day carries turned into points.
A day with no words earns nothing rather than a wisdom of zero.
Nothing here counts the words a commit added.
